title: Broken bookcase and a late order
body:
Case CS-4107
From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@example.com>
Subject: Bookcase and napkins

Hi,

The bookcase from order MP-20107 arrived with a broken shelf, so I'm sending it back and want my $310 refunded. Separately, my napkins on MP-20207 haven't shown up. Will they be here before the weekend?

Priya
